notes.title: New Update v1.05
notes.content:
Hi, everyone.New update is coming.
1:Add a new RaidMode that without timebonus
2:Fixed some bugs
3:Optimized visual effect.Models,textures,lighting and materials
4:Optimized performances
5:New melee weapon system in VR.Now you can use axe to slash the enemies 
6:Optimized collisions and navigation in VR
7:Optimized locomotion in VR
8:Adjust balance in game
In next version,we will add a complete new mode.Include new monsters,new skills and new gameplay system.Hope you will enjoy it.Thanks！

notes.title: HotFix
notes.content:
We apologize to the players because we made a mistake on fov in VR mode.Now we have fixed the bug.
1:fix the fov bug in VR mode
2:optimize the collision in VR mode
3:optimize the graphic
4:open all stages
You can change the resolution scale or other effects in settings to increase the fps.

notes.title: Release date and update
notes.content:
The release date has been confirmed. July 7 12:00am.Thax for supporting.Hope you will enjoy the game.

Update:
1:KB-M has been supported.
2:The mini spec of Non-VR mode has been reduced to GTX650 by our optimization.
3:New mode is developing.
4:Oculus will be supported in July.
